patterns.note: The initial hero section features a dense, overlapping composition of large numbers and text, which dynamically re-arranges and spreads out upon scrolling.
Extremely large, bold sans-serif numbers are used as primary visual elements in the hero, often overlapping and serving as abstract design components rather than purely informational ones.
A vibrant, high-contrast color palette is used for accents, large numbers, and scroll-triggered background shifts, creating a playful and energetic feel.

The hero section undergoes a dramatic scroll-triggered transformation: large numbers and text elements spread out, scale, and fade, while the background color transitions from white to a vibrant pink, then back to white as new content is revealed.
The site uses a 'hero-as-interactive-art' section that completely transforms into a more conventional 'about' section and then a project grid, rather than a static hero.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a complex, scroll-driven animation system (likely using canvas or CSS keyframes with JavaScript for scroll-triggering) to dynamically re-arrange, scale, and fade large numerical and textual elements. This is coupled with full-screen background color transitions that are also tied to scroll depth, creating a fluid and interactive reveal of content.
Project thumbnails use a simple hover effect where the image slightly scales up and a text overlay appears, providing project details.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display numbers (~5-10x body text) are used as abstract visual elements, contrasted with standard-sized, readable sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very dense and overlapping in the initial hero, transitioning to a balanced and airy layout for content sections.

standout: This site's design is highly distinctive for its interactive, almost chaotic, and colorful hero section that uses large numbers and text as abstract visual elements. The dramatic scroll-triggered transformation of this hero, including background color shifts and element re-arrangement, creates a unique and memorable first impression that feels more like an art installation than a typical website.
